description:
Task 496 review: the app keeps its last data and its queued check-ins in
  the browser so it starts without a connection, and until #496 that cache
  carried no owner. On a device two employees share, the second one booted
  into the first one's name and shifts, and their queued taps went out in the
  second one's session. Only a browser has that cache, so this is end-to-end:
  the app is opened with its API unreachable, which makes it render from the
  cache alone. A cache from before the update has no owner recorded and is
  matched by the employee's name. Signing out drops the cache, but only once
  the server answers: with the connection gone it keeps the employee signed
  in with their data rather than half-clearing the device (spec EC-S9). What
  a session that ended without Abmelden leaves is cleared at the next
  employee's sync, all but the taps it could not send. Those taps, and the
  ones another employee left in the cache from before the update, wait for
  their owner's next sign-in, oldest first with the employee's own; a queued
  tap the server refuses is shown with its reason, and kept for the next
  sign-in if the employee signs out before reading it.

  from a Gültig ab; one version is valid on a day, and the one it replaces is
  then Abgelöst. The rules themselves (the Gültig ab checks, at most one version

  unit tests of wolfinne_ifms_customization (tests/test_quote_versioning.py) and
  are not walked again here. This feature is end-to-end for what only the
  browser shows: that the header offers "Neue Version" and opens the new
  Angebot, that the form shows its number, Version and proposed Gültig ab, that
  the "Versionen" smart button lists the versions with the columns Version,
  Gültig ab, Gültig bis and Versionsstatus, and that the quotation report
  prints the version under the number (TEST_CASES_QUOTE_VERSIONING.md TC-02,
  TC-08, TC-10).

  start after version 1, and a Sonderreinigung Auftrag (Manuell since #483) is
  proposed today rather than the 1st of next month.

  Kategorie "Sonderreinigung" with a product, and the signers "Administrator"
